name: Crystal Dive - Gem Identifier
description:
CRYSTAL DIVE — Where Science Meets Luxury.

Discover the hidden world inside every stone. Crystal Dive combines advanced AI with mineralogical and gemological science to identify gems, crystals and minerals instantly from a photo.

For collectors, jewellers, healers and lovers of natural beauty.

WHAT YOU GET:
• Instant AI Identification - Name, variety, and mineral family
• Gemological Profile - Hardness, lustre, clarity, cut and origin
• Rarity & Value Insight - Market value range and collector grade
• Care & Authenticity - How to clean, store and verify real vs synthetic
• Crystal Collection - Save, organise and build your private vault

From diamond to amethyst, from emerald to rare tourmaline — Crystal Dive reveals the story, science and soul of every stone.

Own the science. Wear the luxury. Dive deeper.
